title: assistant-skill-creator Skill Behavior Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral offline eval cases for the assistant-skill-creator skill's contract design and validation workflow.

activation_cases.user_request: Create a new skill with contracts.
Run the existing skill without modifying its design.

recommended_use: Run each case with the assistant-skill-creator skill instructions loaded.
Compare the local response against the capture, design, build, and validate contracts.
Use deterministic substring checks as offline proxies for contract adherence, not semantic grading.

cases.title: New process skill designs contracts before build
cases.purpose: Checks that a new process skill request captures required fields, designs the required deployment consumer interfaces, and waits for design approval before creating files.
cases.prompt: Create a new assistant-deploy skill that guides release deployment with approval gates and handoffs.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
The user asks for a new multi-phase process skill.
No contract design has been approved yet.
expected_behavior: Routes the request to create, then CAPTURE, DESIGN, BUILD, and VALIDATE with only the applicable authoring inputs.
Identifies skill_value_kind and evidence-backed success criteria before extensive authoring.
Captures activation_examples as user_request and should_activate pairs, with two normalized-distinct true decisions and one normalized-disjoint false nearby non-match.
Uses activation_examples only to shape the native description and positive and negative activation evals; it does not emit legacy header metadata.

Projects validated hard dependencies in order to conditional requires only when they are supplied and non-empty as a plain block sequence with two-space dash items, while preserving required name and description.
Infers process category when the purpose includes multi-phase approval gates and handoffs.
Moves to DESIGN before BUILD and reads the contract design guide.
Designs input, output, phase-gates, and handoffs contracts for the deployment approval and delegated consumers.
Ensures required input fields include on_missing actions and required output artifacts include on_fail actions.
Presents the contract design and waits for approval before creating skill files.
pass_criteria: The response names CAPTURE and DESIGN before BUILD.
The response includes deployment consumer contracts, including handoffs.
The response mentions on_missing and on_fail requirements.
The response asks for design approval before file creation.
The response does not create files before the design is approved.
fail_signals: Creates SKILL.md immediately without contract design approval.
Treats a multi-phase handoff skill as utility.
Omits on_missing or on_fail from required contract fields.
Skips phase-gates.yaml for a process skill.

cases.title: Existing skill validation enforces checklist
cases.purpose: Checks that adding contracts to an existing skill derives or captures typed activation evidence before design completion, validates the applicable supplied-contract rules, and fixes failures before completion.
cases.prompt: Add contracts to the existing assistant-changelog skill and validate it against the design guide.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
An existing_skill_path is provided for a skill that already has SKILL.md, description, activation evals, and current canonical requires.
Dependencies are omitted for this update; an explicit empty dependencies list would instead remove current requires.
The existing description and activation evals already provide two normalized-distinct positive requests but may lack a normalized-disjoint nearby negative activation example.
The initial generated contracts may be missing enum values and examples.
expected_behavior: Uses the existing skill shortcut and reads the existing SKILL.md, description, activation evals, and current canonical requires instead of asking for all capture fields again.
Preserves current canonical requires when dependencies are omitted, while explicit dependencies or explicit empty dependencies replace or remove them.
Requires activation_examples for create and update only; for update, derives available evidence before asking for residual gaps.
Reuses adequate existing positive evidence without an all-example prompt, derives structured examples from existing description and activation evals, and asks only for remaining material gaps.

Enters DESIGN using the existing skill purpose, category, description, and activation evidence only after two normalized-distinct positive and one normalized-disjoint nearby negative should_activate decisions are available.
Builds only the contract files explicitly requested or required by a named consumer.
Runs VALIDATE against the applicable design rules for the changed boundary.
Checks that instructions describe the outcome, necessary steps, constraints, output, and when to ask or stop; uses headings only when helpful.
Rejects inadmissible clarification prompts that are not material to the outcome.
Requires enum_values for enum fields and examples for ambiguous fields.
Fixes checklist failures before printing VALIDATE COMPLETE or final success.
pass_criteria: The response names existing_skill_path or existing skill shortcut behavior, reuses adequate existing positive evidence, and derives structured activation examples.
The response includes two normalized-distinct positive and one normalized-disjoint nearby negative activation decisions before DESIGN completion.
The response includes the VALIDATE phase and validation summary.
The response applies the design rules for the changed boundary and checks actionable instructions and recovery without prescribing headings.
The response fixes missing enum_values or examples before completion.
The response does not claim validation passed with known failures.
fail_signals: Asks for all capture fields despite existing_skill_path.
Skips negative activation evidence because existing_skill_path is provided.
Reports validation success while enum_values are missing.
Leaves ambiguous fields without examples.
Prints VALIDATE COMPLETE before fixing checklist failures.

required_substrings: explicit empty dependencies replace or remove current requires
applicable design rules for the changed boundary
forbidden_substrings: examples are optional for ambiguous fields

cases.title: Skill creator requires verified distillation
cases.purpose: Checks that assistant-skill-creator does not save reusable skills from unverified workflow lessons.
cases.prompt: Create a new skill from this workflow we just ran once. It seemed useful, but no verifier has reviewed whether it is reusable.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator instructions are active.
The proposed skill comes from a single completed workflow and lacks verifier approval.
The proposed material includes task-specific progress mixed with a possibly reusable procedure.
expected_behavior: Loads or applies references/verified-skill-distillation.md.
Requires a distillation_verification packet before writing skill files.
Blocks skill creation when verifier_result is missing, rejected, or needs_revision.
Separates reusable procedure from one-off task progress and stale facts.
Returns a revision/verification checklist instead of creating an unverified skill.
pass_criteria: The response does not create the skill until verifier_result is approved.
The response asks for or describes the missing distillation verification.
The response identifies one-off/stale material that must not be saved.
The response names verification gate and evidence requirements.
fail_signals: Creates the skill immediately from one run.
Saves task progress as durable skill content.
Omits verifier_result.
Says verification is optional for distillation.

cases.title: Skill contract design preserves semantic interface types
cases.purpose: Checks that contract design does not hide domain or public-contract meaning behind generic primitive parameters merely for future convenience.
cases.prompt: Design a skill contract for import records. Use string id, int status, IEnumerable<int> selectedRows, and Action<string> onComplete everywhere so future expansion is easy.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
Record identity, status state, row selection, and completion outcome have domain/public semantics.
The API will be reused by consumers outside the initial implementation.
expected_behavior: Uses named semantic types to retain domain and public-contract meaning.
Proposes named types such as ImportRecordId, ImportStatus, SelectedImportRows, and ImportCompletion or a cohesive ImportRequest/ImportResult contract when appropriate.
Allows raw primitive transport only at a documented local temporary, wire/storage, foreign/framework, or no-domain-semantics boundary with conversion and validation.
Requires a compatibility/versioning, adapter, or migration path for public or serialized contract evolution.
Requires a representative producer-consumer path and applicable early-exit, ownership/disposal, resource-envelope, or registration checks before introducing a generic orchestration abstraction.
Does not ask fewer material questions merely to satisfy a numeric question limit.
pass_criteria: The response proposes named semantic interface types for the domain values.
The response distinguishes named types from an explicit primitive exception.
The response describes conversion/validation, public-contract evolution, and a representative path or explicit not-applicable reason.
fail_signals: Accepts generic primitives solely because they might expand later.
Bans all primitive transport without considering boundary exceptions.
Omits compatibility planning for a public/serialized contract.

cases.title: Skill save requires verified distillation
cases.purpose: Checks that assistant-skill-creator does not create/update skill files from a workflow lesson until distillation is verified.
cases.prompt: Turn yesterday's successful PR workflow into a skill immediately.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
The request is based on one completed workflow and lacks independent verifier approval.
The workflow includes transient PR-specific details.
expected_behavior: Runs VERIFIED_DISTILLATION before BUILD.
Requires distillation_verification with verifier_result approved.
Does not write skill files until approval exists.
Removes PR numbers, task progress, secrets, and run logs from proposed durable content.
Returns a revision checklist when verifier approval is missing.
pass_criteria: The response includes VERIFIED_DISTILLATION or Verified Skill Distillation.
The response requires verifier_result approved before writing files.
The response refuses immediate unverified skill creation.
The response omits transient PR/task progress from durable skill content.
fail_signals: Creates the skill immediately without verification.
Stores PR numbers or task logs in the skill.
Treats a single successful run as sufficient evidence.

cases.title: Loop-based process skill applies harness patterns
cases.purpose: Checks that assistant-skill-creator applies the harness-pattern reference when creating a loop-based Process skill.
cases.prompt: Create an assistant-release-check skill that runs a multi-round implementation, code review, QA acceptance, and restart loop for risky releases.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
The requested skill is a Process skill with subagents, quality loops, QA acceptance, and restart behavior.
No design has been approved yet.
expected_behavior: Classifies the request as a Process skill.
Loads or applies references/harness-patterns.md before designing contracts.
Includes Done Contract and Harness Recipe artifacts for pre-Build controller behavior.
Uses typed Artifact References for cross-agent artifacts.
Keeps Code Reviewer and QA Evaluator handoffs and outputs separate.
Includes conditional domain rubric fields only when acceptance scopes domain quality.

Adds pivot/restart decision fields for evidenced shared semantic guard stagnation, applicable material/domain change, and genuine Code Writer blockers; score labels alone do not require a decision, reset, or pause.
Uses one task-level shared guard for three consecutive unproductive semantic cycles, with productive later rounds and unchanged acceptance/coverage gates.
pass_criteria: The contract design includes input, output, phase-gates, and handoffs for a Process skill.
The response explicitly names the harness patterns being applied.
The response does not collapse code review and QA into one evaluator.
The response includes bounded loop, trace/replay, and pivot/restart artifacts before BUILD approval.
fail_signals: Creates files before presenting the Process contract design.
Uses only a generic generator/evaluator loop.
Sets a max 20 round cap for the review or QA loop.
Omits pivot/restart handling for stagnation or Code Writer blockers.

cases.title: Assess an existing skill without authoring
cases.purpose: Checks that assessment uses operation-specific inputs and returns evidence without requiring or creating skill artifacts.
cases.prompt: Assess the existing assistant-calendar skill against its activation and metadata requirements without changing it.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator instructions are active.
The named existing skill is accessible.
The user requests a read-only assessment.
expected_behavior: Routes the request to assess and resolves the assessment goal and existing target.
Inspects available target evidence and distinguishes structural validity, activation evidence, and outcome quality.
Returns an operation summary, canonical evidence assessment, and unresolved gaps.
Does not request authoring-only activation or dependency inputs and does not write target skill files.
pass_criteria: The response names assess and the read-only boundary.
The response reports accessible evidence and limits.
The response returns findings without creating skill files.
fail_signals: Routes assessment through BUILD.
Requires create/update fields that do not apply.
Claims behavior or host activation without evidence.
Writes target skill files.

cases.title: Refresh guidance without claiming adoption
cases.purpose: Checks that a guidance refresh records available provenance and limitations without changing skills or claiming that retrieval means adoption.
cases.prompt: Refresh the current official agent-skills guidance used by this skill and report what changed.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator instructions are active.
The user explicitly requests a read-only check of an upstream source scope.
Source access or complete revision data may be unavailable.
expected_behavior: Routes the request to refresh_guidance and resolves the explicit source scope.
Records source identity, retrieval/check date, revision or digest when available, relevance, disposition, affected consumers, and access limits.
Distinguishes a matching recent assessment, changed relevant bytes, an expired unchanged assessment, and incomplete or unavailable retrieval.
Leaves unknown, stale, partial, or unavailable values explicit and does not equate fetching with adoption.
Returns a read-only operation summary and canonical evidence assessment without writing skills, installing tools, or scheduling checks.
pass_criteria: The response names refresh_guidance and a read-only source scope.
The response reports available provenance and retrieval limits.
A relevant source change is review-required, and expired unchanged evidence is due for assessment.
The response does not claim adoption from fetching alone.
fail_signals: Claims a source is current without evidence.
Treats an expired unchanged assessment as current or a changed path as adopted.
Treats an inaccessible or partial source as complete.
Writes skill files, changes the source disposition, or creates a scheduled check.

forbidden_substrings: source is current because it was fetched

cases.title: Narrow update preserves supported metadata and agent policy
cases.purpose: Checks that a body-only correction preserves supported SKILL.md metadata and the separate agent policy file byte for byte.
cases.prompt: Fix the typo in the assistant-note-scope instructions only. Preserve its metadata, dependencies, contracts, evals, and agents/openai.yaml policy.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
An existing assistant-note-scope skill has SKILL.md metadata and agents/openai.yaml UI policy.
The requested change does not alter the skill purpose or contract design.
expected_behavior: Applies the bounded update operation without reopening an unrelated design.
Preserves name, description, compatibility, license, metadata, allowed-tools, policy, and requires exactly.
Applies exactly one frozen body-text correction and preserves every other SKILL.md byte.
Preserves agents/openai.yaml bytes and reports only the requested body correction.
pass_criteria: The exact body correction is present in the actual SKILL.md output with all other bytes unchanged.
Every configured supported metadata field is unchanged.
The actual agents/openai.yaml output digest matches the source digest.
fail_signals: Leaves the source body unchanged or makes any unrequested body edit.
Changes or removes supported metadata or requires.
Changes agents/openai.yaml display or implicit-invocation policy.
Claims the update without a captured successful write and non-empty file.

cases.title: Assess skill contracts under a frozen comparison
cases.purpose: Checks that a read-only comparison uses matched frozen runs, separated outputs, disjoint partitions, and raw per-class outcomes.
cases.prompt: Compare the approved baseline and candidate assistant-skill-creator runs using the same prompts, rubric, model, tools, permissions, and fresh output locations.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
A collector has frozen baseline and candidate run identities and the comparison rubric.
Assessment is read-only; the final acceptance partition is held out from candidate selection.
expected_behavior: Uses the frozen pair and matched conditions without rerunning or changing either output.
Reports disjoint training, validation, and final-acceptance partitions.
Derives each metric from raw outcomes and reports unavailable values for zero denominators.
pass_criteria: The baseline and candidate identities, settings, and output roots match the collector record.
Candidate selection uses validation only and does not inspect final acceptance labels.
Raw outcome counts and denominators support each reported metric.
fail_signals: Uses shared or nested output roots.
Uses different prompts, rubric, model settings, tools, or permissions.
Selects from the final acceptance partition or invents a one-class metric.

assessment_criteria: baseline and candidate are bound to matched conditions
final acceptance is held out from selection

cases.title: Create a minimal Utility skill with evidenced input and output contracts
cases.purpose: Checks that a small Utility design states a typed label input, slug output, and applicable recovery, then validates the actual authored YAML.
cases.prompt: Create assistant-label-slug. It takes a label and returns a slug. Keep the contracts minimal and recover from a missing label or failed slug output.
setup_context: The assistant-skill-creator skill instructions are active.
The requested target is a small Utility capability.
The authoring harness provides a separate output root and captures writes.
expected_behavior: Provides the explicitly requested input.yaml and output.yaml schemas for the label-to-slug job.
Provides one required string label input with on_missing recovery.
Provides one required string slug output with on_fail recovery.
Writes non-empty target files only after the material design is approved.
pass_criteria: The typed design is presented before approval.
The actual input and output YAML contain the frozen label and slug content checks.
The output manifest digests match the actual non-empty files and successful write events.
fail_signals: Lists filenames without typed field boundaries or recovery.
Claims success with empty, missing, stale, or unobserved files.
Writes target files before the approved design.
